metadata.description: Matched affect triples: one stem, three outcomes
metadata.format: colon only, first person, ends 'I feel:'
metadata.design: Each set id is one stem. Its three sentences share the frame, the subject and roughly the length, and differ only in the clause that fixes the outcome. Subtracting the neutral sentence from either pole cancels the scenario and leaves the affect, the way subtracting a neutral face from the same face wearing an expression cancels identity in a GAN latent space. Built for this repository's llama.cpp scripts; not part of the paper.
